description: This file contains shell functions and scripts related to GitHub pull request branch management, including URL resolution, push operations via GraphQL, and remote setup.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the push URL for the PR head repository based on environment variables.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Pushes changes to a forked repository branch via GitHub GraphQL createCommitOnBranch API.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Resolves the HTTPS URL for the PR head repository.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Checks if the PR head branch matches the expected branch name.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Sets up the prhead remote in git to the URL resolved for the PR head repository.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Resolves the SHA of the remote PR head branch, fallback to HTTPS URL if necessary.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Pushes local changes to the PR branch, with fallbacks to GraphQL operation if git push fails due to permissions.
